items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: The /inbox page of @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app, generated from the plugin's own source, for an application that copies the page out to own it entirely: a rail with All, Unread, Pending and the notification categories, a list grouped as Pending, Today and Earlier, a detail pane with read, unread, delete and open, decisions through registered renderers and pending sources, j / k navigation and realtime refresh. Normally register the plugin instead: it provides this page at /inbox and the header inbox button, and is customized through its options, its extension points and routeComponentOverrides.
items.docs: Generated from packages/plugins/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client/inbox-page; do not install it to get an inbox, register @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app on the server and client instead. Install it only to own the page: replace the plugin's page with a route component override for routeId @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app:inbox (routeComponentOverrides in defineAppRuntime()) whose page renders <InboxPage /> from inbox-page.tsx, and edit the copy. It keeps the plugin's translations (namespace @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app) and its extension lists: renderers and pending sources registered with inboxRenderersToken and inboxSourcesToken still reach the copy.

items.name: inbox-button
items.title: Inbox Button
items.description: A header button linking to the inbox, with an amber badge for what waits on the viewer or the unread count, its tooltip, and the browser tab title prefix. Use it in an application header of your own; the in-app notification plugin already registers a header inbox button, so use this only when you replace it (headerActionOverrides on inbox). Presentational: pass inboxBadge(waiting, unread), with the unread count from useInboxUnreadCount() of @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client/inbox.
items.docs: Render <InboxButton badge={inboxBadge(waiting, unread)} /> inside a TooltipProvider, with inboxBadge from #components/inbox-badge, waiting what your inbox counts as waiting (0 without decisions) and unread from useInboxUnreadCount() of @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client/inbox; useDocumentTitleBadge(badge?.text ?? null) prefixes the tab title. Add the inboxButton.* keys its README lists to client/locales/.
